title: 20 October 2015: Ringo Starr live at Massey Hall, Toronto, Ontario, Canada
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at Massey Hall in Toronto, Canada, on 20 October 2015.

It was the 31st show of the 12th All-Starr Band’s tour of North and South America, which lasted for 39 dates between February and October 2015.

Earlier in the day Starr visited Indigo Bay & Bloor in Toronto where he chatted to Indigo CEO Heather Reisman about his book Photograph.

Having fun with Heather at the indigo bookstore promoting photographs Ringo peace and love????????? pic.twitter.com/Xbdv4Ds9ue

— #RingoStarr (@ringostarrmusic) October 20, 2015

Starr returned to Massey Hall on 28 September 2022.

The 12th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, keyboards
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Todd Rundgren: vocals, guitar, harmonica, bass, percussion, keyboards
  • Richard Page: vocals, bass guitar, acoustic guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, percussion

TO, Canada. See you soon – looking forward to his town
